AnnualReturnObservation.description: The performance of one fund in one calendar year.
AnnualReturnObservation.title: AnnualReturnObservation

AumHistory.description: The assets of one fund over time.
AumHistory.title: AumHistory

AumMetricType.description:
Which capital figure of a fund a value describes.

Only the fund-level members may populate the assets-under-management
field. Registered capital, the statutory minimum and the assets of
the manager are stored under their own metric and never as the assets
of the fund.
AumMetricType.title: AumMetricType

CapitalObservation.description: One dated capital figure of a fund.
CapitalObservation.title: CapitalObservation

FeeTier.description:
One row of a conditional fee table.

An exit fee of ten per cent in the first year and nothing after three
years is three tiers, never one number.
FeeTier.title: FeeTier

FeeTierBasis.description: What decides which tier of a fee applies.
FeeTierBasis.title: FeeTierBasis

FundParty.description: A company acting for the fund, such as its manager.
FundParty.title: FundParty

HistoricalValueSeries.description:
One measured quantity of one share class over time.

The identity of the series lives on the series itself, so values of
different metrics, classes or currencies cannot end up mixed.
HistoricalValueSeries.title: HistoricalValueSeries

InferenceReference.description: The legal ground of a value that no source states explicitly.
InferenceReference.title: InferenceReference

InvestmentHorizonValue.description:
The holding period recommended for a fund.

``recommended_years`` stays the single representative number so that
existing consumers keep working. A range reports its lower bound
there, and "at least five years" reports five.
InvestmentHorizonValue.title: InvestmentHorizonValue

ReturnSeriesType.description: Which period a reported performance covers.
ReturnSeriesType.title: ReturnSeriesType

ReturnType.description: Which return concept a stated percentage describes.
ReturnType.title: ReturnType

ValueOrigin.description: Whether a value was published by the source or derived from law.
ValueOrigin.title: ValueOrigin
